firmwareDropdown.description: Firmware versions offered in the FW update dropdown, as semver ranges per product. The rule used is the one with the highest fromBazecor that is <= the running Bazecor version. A product missing from a rule shows every version. Custom firmware is never filtered.

sk20.description: Superkeys 2.0: Bazecor shows the SK 2.0 UI instead of the legacy dual-function/superkeys UI.

lens.description: Layer Lens: needs the firmware to report overlay/layer packets over raw HID. Raise never exposes it.
